verify.note: wowsimcli on this request, 180s, seed 1 (the published number is this sim)

summary: The cat build, keeping Faerie Fire on the boss for the raid. Forever has no Faerie Fire (Feral): the cat casts the caster Faerie Fire, free in Cat Form. Its own attacks gain from the armor cut, so it costs only a few GCDs.
rotation: Opener: plain Cat Form, no Prowl. A Night Elf uses Shadowmeld in the fight for Ravage.
Racials, trinkets and potions on cooldown. Berserk with the on-use trinket. Elune's Light outside Berserk.
Faerie Fire first after the cooldowns, and again at under 7s left. In Cat Form it's free, with a 1.5s GCD and no cooldown, so a miss is retried on the next GCD
Shifting Power at 50 Energy or less, unless a Ferocious Bite is due (5 combo points and Rip has 6s or more)
Ferocious Bite at any combo points in the last 2s
Rip at 5 combo points when it is down (not in the last 8s)
Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points and 35 Energy while Rip has 6s or more left (or in the last 8s)
Shadowmeld into Ravage from behind on Clearcasting, or in the last 10s with the Energy for it
Rake below 5 combo points when it is down (not in the last 6s)
caveats: Costs 10.2 / 8.3 / 4.3 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s, against the same build without the duty (869.7 / 858.5 / 846.9 against 879.9 / 866.8 / 851.2). With Faerie Fire (Feral) (a 1s GCD) it was 5.5 / 4.5 / 1.7.

Faerie Fire (Feral) is gone from Forever (16857 and 17390 to 17392 have no client rows). In Cat, Bear and Dire Bear Form a druid casts the caster Faerie Fire, which costs nothing there (development notes).
Rip's client ranks from level 31 up are 6-9% weaker than Era's. Era values would add 1.6% DPS.
Idol of the Dream (Rip lasts 2s longer) is 3.0 DPS ahead of Howling Idol at 180s.
Clearcasting is fished for before the pull. It's worth 4.6 DPS to the Night Elf.
Unverified: Shred's flat bonus, attack power on Rip and Ferocious Bite, and what Rend and Tear affects.
Rake's 5.5% of attack power a tick is fit to testers' rank 1 ticks. Keeping Rake up is 38-42 DPS ahead of skipping it.
Only one +2% crit elixir. Grizzly instead of Ferocity adds only its 25 Strength.
Tiger's Fury is gone in Forever.
Cat swings vary 20% either way. The server's real range is unknown.
The melee group has Windfury Totem and a second shaman's Grace of Air. No Elemental Sharpening Stone, since its recipe comes from Molten Core.
Takes Feral Swiftness 2 (movement speed) instead of Natural Shapeshifter's point. It costs 0.0 / 0.0 / 3.5 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s, from shapeshift mana in long fights.
No explosive here, because EZ-Thro Dark Bomb's GCDs go to Faerie Fire. Using it is 1.8 / 0.8 / 0.0 DPS behind at 120s / 180s / 300s.
notes: druid__feral-cat.json with the raid's Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness off (Forever's two share the minor armor slot, standards 20, so with the curse on the druid's own Faerie Fire adds nothing) and the level60_ff rotation. The base request's EZ-Thro Dark Bomb is removed too (it loses on the duty build, standards 11). Everything else is the base request. 2026-10-29: the rotation casts the caster Faerie Fire (9907) instead of Faerie Fire (Feral) (17392), the level60_ff rotation regenerated by tools/rotopt/druid_presets.sh with the same knobs, and the request's rotation edited to match. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
